is_fee_on_transfer_token.meaning: the deposited token deducts a percentage fee on each transfer

deposit_amount.meaning: amount parameter deposited by the user via increaseTokenBalance()

tokens_actually_received.meaning: tokens actually received by the contract after the fee-on-transfer deduction

total_deposited_across_users.meaning: total tokens deposited across users in the quantified scenario

protocol_deficit.meaning: reported token deficit between recorded obligations and actual holdings

contract_insolvent.meaning: the contract owes more than it holds (recorded obligations exceed actual token holdings)

assumptions: increaseTokenBalance() is callable by the depositing user without additional authorization requirements (report does not state a caller restriction).
The 1% fee and 9,900 received figure are the report's illustrative scenario for the fee-on-transfer deduction.
The 1,000,000 deposited / 10,000 deficit figures are a potential quantified example, not an observed incident.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who calls increaseTokenBalance() or any authorization requirement, so the caller scope of the deposit scenario is not fixed.
The exact relation between recorded creatorBalance and actual holdings after the deposit is not given as a numeric identity; only the qualitative insolvency outcome is stated.

limitations: Only the protocol_insolvency impact is formalized; balance_inflation, last_depositor_loss and campaign_funding_failures are handled in separate passes.
The conservation relation is bound at the amount level using the report's illustrative 10,000/9,900 figures; higher-fee scaling is not separately quantified.
contract_insolvent is a report-grounded Boolean outcome for the insolvency impact; its numeric definition is not supplied by the report.
